# AirnodeHub Community

> An open catalog of runnable, frontend-only AirnodeHub use cases, maintained by API3 and built for community contribution. It is not an official API3 product.

All demonstrations run in the browser without a proxy, database, account, or private API key. They use live AirnodeHub operations and expose the request, response, signer, verification result, and derived output.

An Airnode attestation proves which signer returned specific bytes for a specific request at a specific time. It does not prove that the underlying real-world claim is objectively true. Source policy prefers first-party, then explicitly API3-maintained, then third-party sources. API3-maintained is a policy tier, not an inferred provenance label, and no current ETH/USD example supplies it.

## Working use cases

- [Trust-Aware Agent](https://airnodehub-community-preview.pages.dev/?project=trust-aware-agent): Prefer provider-run Nodary, verify it locally, and release ETH/USD only after the trust policy passes. [Agent prompt](https://airnodehub-community-preview.pages.dev/prompts/trust-aware-agent.md).
- [Asset Price Monitor](https://airnodehub-community-preview.pages.dev/?project=market-integrity-monitor): Use first-party Nodary as the reference and compare verified relay prices without losing their receipts. [Agent prompt](https://airnodehub-community-preview.pages.dev/prompts/market-integrity-monitor.md).
- [Disaster Evidence Map](https://airnodehub-community-preview.pages.dev/?project=disaster-evidence-map): Attach signed event and location inputs to map markers and alerts. [Agent prompt](https://airnodehub-community-preview.pages.dev/prompts/disaster-evidence-map.md).
- [Verified Change Tracker](https://airnodehub-community-preview.pages.dev/?project=revision-witness): Compare two signed ETH/USD snapshots over time and preserve the receipt behind each value. [Agent prompt](https://airnodehub-community-preview.pages.dev/prompts/revision-witness.md).

## Project resources

- [Source repository](https://github.com/api3dao/airnodehub-community): Application code, use-case briefs, verification utilities, fixtures, and contribution guidance.
- [Use-case briefs](https://github.com/api3dao/airnodehub-community/tree/main/use-cases): Problem statements, trust boundaries, implemented flows, and acceptance criteria.
- [Official AirnodeHub catalog](https://airnodehub.api3.org/llms.txt): Available Airnode listings and consumer interface.
- [Full AirnodeHub operation catalog](https://airnodehub.api3.org/llms-full.txt): Complete live operation inventory.
- [Consumer documentation](https://airnodehub-docs.api3.org/api-consumers/): Resolve, inspect, call, and verify flow.
- [Attestation documentation](https://airnodehub-docs.api3.org/airnode/attestation): EIP-191 signing and local verification details.

## Optional

- [Contribution guide](https://github.com/api3dao/airnodehub-community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): How to add a focused, testable community use case.
- [Project ideas](https://github.com/api3dao/airnodehub-community/blob/main/IDEAS.md): Candidate demonstrations and reusable building blocks.
